decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and numbered 715/01A, Received 9 June 2011, Existing Elevations, Received 21 April 2011 and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extension is occupied.

Condition : 3 - No additional flank window or other glazed openings shall be formed in the eastern or southern walls of the extensions hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extensions hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 5 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 0800 to 1800 on Mondays to Friday and 0800 to 1300 on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The window within the first floor bathroom on the eastern elevations shall be obscure glazed to a minimum level of 3 and shall be non-opening unless the parts of the window which can be opened are more than 1.7m above the floor of the room in which the window is within. The windows shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glass.
description: Erection of ground and first floor rear extensions to the existing house
